# BoomOpen Workflow Kit Pro (v5.5.0)

> Proactive `smart-hybrid` default preset (auto Mode A/B + 17-language routing, plus < 2.3 KB `frontier-guardrails` slim Mode A), 3-Wave Contract-First sharding, Wave 2.5 spec-to-code reconciliation, multi-round project audit (/audit), multi-session /autopilot, and 14 local CLI commands across 5 AI coding IDEs (Google Antigravity 2.0, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).

## Canonical Inventory
- Production Website: https://boomopen.com
- Version: v5.5.0
- Platforms (5): Antigravity 2.0, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot
- Default Preset: `smart-hybrid` (auto Mode A/B across 14 entry files; presets: `smart-hybrid`, `frontier-guardrails` < 2.3 KB slim, `solo-fast`, `deep-architect`, `adversarial-team`, plus `carbon-guardrails` alias; 22 config keys = 20 enum + 2 line limits)
- Slash Commands: 36 base commands (93 files: 87 workflows + 6 shared references, including /onboard, /pr, /pr:review, /release, /audit, /autopilot, /conduct, /cook, /code)
- Sub-Agents: 22 domain specialists
- Review Teams: 18 adversarial 3-role review teams (72 files: Tech Lead, Executor, Reviewer)
- Skills Vault: 1,462 indexed skills (22 core + 1,440 library across 19 domains, shared via ~/.agents/skills_library)
- Multilingual Routing: 17 supported languages (opt-in via `smart-hybrid` or `workflows.naturalLanguageResearchTrigger`)

## Quick Install (From Git Clone)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Kennyboom/BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro.git
cd BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro
node cli/install.js install --all
node cli/install.js doctor
```

## Local CLI Subcommands (14)
- `install` / `uninstall` / `list` / `doctor` / `settings`: SHA-256 manifest installer (14 entry files, `--as-plugin` bundle, opt-in `--with-hooks` on Claude/Antigravity/Cursor) & Control Center (`--ui`)
- `research` / `design` / `plan` / `cook` / `reconcile`: Fast local validators (`RES-G1..G4`, `DESIGN-G1..G4`, `PLAN-G1..G5`, `COOK-G1..G4`), wave packet compilers & Wave 2.5 spec-to-code reconciliation (`REC-G1..G4`)
- `audit` / `ledger` / `conduct` / `check`: Multi-round project audit (`.boomopen/audit-ledger.json`, `audit rollback --round 1 --yes`), `.boomopen/project-ledger.json` phase ratchet (`ledger rollback --phase PHASE-1 --yes`), Multi-Engine Council (`conduct council --task review --prompt "..."`), and 2-tier static gate (`--strict-phase --no-stubs`)
